comment: Manual corrections for perl 5.44 headers. See src/apidoc_patches.rs for the schema and doc/architecture-apidoc-patches.md for the merge model.

patches.name: hv_stores
patches.reason: The apidoc_defn added in 5.44 declares the 3rd arg as `U32 flags` (apparently copy-pasted from hv_deletes/hv_name_sets which do take flags), but the macro is hv_stores(hv, key, val) and passes val to hv_store's `SV *val` parameter. Without the fix the generated hv_stores types val as U32 (downstream E0308).
